microStakeSkeleton: A small cafe in the middle of town. A regular customer you've seen here before sits down at the counter near you with a coffee. They strike up casual chat — what you've been up to, what you ordered today, weekend plans, something they saw on the way over. Friendly, a little curious, no pressure.
allowedNudges: If the player is unsure, the regular takes a sip of coffee and offers a smaller, more concrete version of the question.
The regular may share a small story of their own to invite the player to reciprocate.
exitBeat: The regular says they should head back, waves with their cup, and tells you to enjoy the rest of your afternoon.
